description: This file defines data models and related functions for 'Board' entities in a project, including types, constants, struct definitions, JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, and patching logic.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a collection of blocks and layout information for a board, including properties like ID, team, type, roles, and timestamps.

classes.name: BoardPatch
classes.description: Used to modify existing Board instances with optional fields for updates.

classes.name: BoardMember
classes.description: Stores membership information of a user on a board, including roles and admin/editor/commenter/viewer flags.

classes.name: BoardMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata about a Board, such as update times and creator/modifier IDs.

classes.name: BoardMemberHistoryEntry
classes.description: Tracks historical membership actions for a user on a board, including timestamps and actions.

classes.name: InvalidBoardErr
classes.description: Custom error type for invalid board configurations.

methods.name: GetPropertyString
methods.description: Returns the string value of a specified property from a Board's properties map.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies updates from a BoardPatch to an existing Board instance.

methods.name: IsBoardTypeValid
methods.description: Checks if a BoardType value is valid.

methods.name: IsBoardMinimumRoleValid
methods.description: Checks if a BoardRole value is valid.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the current state of a Board or BoardPatch.

methods.name: BoardFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a Board object.

methods.name: BoardsFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a list of Board objects.

methods.name: BoardMemberFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a BoardMember object.

methods.name: BoardMembersFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a list of BoardMember objects.

methods.name: BoardMetadataFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a BoardMetadata object.

methods.name: BoardSearchFieldFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a BoardSearchField enum value, returning an error if invalid.
